SyncedLink.title: SyncedLink
SyncedLink.description: A clearnet bookmark or Home App shortcut synced to the authenticated user's cloud library.

title.description: Display label for the bookmark or Home App shortcut.

url.description: Clearnet http:// or https:// destination URL.

kind.description: Whether this item came from Bookmarks, Home Apps, or History.

SessionMonitor.title: SessionMonitor
SessionMonitor.description: Real-time ongoing gaming session statistics and budget/time guard state synced per authenticated user.

siteHost.description: Active clearnet host or redacted label for .onion sessions.

guardEnabled.description: Whether Session Guard alerts are active.

timeLimitMinutes.description: Configured session time limit in minutes.

currencyLabel.description: Display currency code such as BDT or USD.

totalRounds.description: Total completed rounds recorded in session.

netProfit.description: Net profit or loss across recorded rounds.

averageCrashMultiplier.description: Mean crash multiplier across recorded rounds.

maxCrashMultiplier.description: Highest crash multiplier across recorded rounds.

isMonitoringActive.description: Whether live remote sync is actively publishing from the device.

SessionRound.title: SessionRound
SessionRound.description: A completed game round log synced for remote cross-device statistical monitoring.

betAmount.description: Wagered stake for the completed round.

clientTimestampMs.description: Client timestamp when round was logged.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Trusted admin role registry entry keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was created.

AdminServerConfig.title: AdminServerConfig
AdminServerConfig.description: Server-side remote configuration toggles managed by administrators.

maintenanceMode.description: Whether global maintenance mode is enabled.

strictTorRequired.description: Whether strict Tor .onion routing enforcement is mandated server-side.

remoteTelemetryEnabled.description: Whether remote diagnostic telemetry streaming is enabled.

forceAdBlockSync.description: Whether clients should force-sync global ad-block filter lists.

emergencyLockdown.description: Whether emergency maximum-privacy lockdown posture is active.

maintenanceBanner.description: Short notice banner shown during maintenance or lockdown.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who last modified the config.

MaintenanceLog.title: MaintenanceLog
MaintenanceLog.description: Audit and maintenance event log entry recorded by administrators.

action.description: Short summary of the maintenance action.

severity.description: Severity level of the maintenance log.

actorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the acting administrator.

actorEmail.description: Email address of the acting administrator.

clientTimestampMs.description: Client epoch timestamp in milliseconds for deterministic ordering.

/users/{userId}/synced_links/{linkId}.description: Per-user cloud-synced bookmarks and Home App shortcuts.

/users/{userId}/session_monitors/{monito.description: Per-user real-time session statistics and guard state for remote observation.

/users/{userId}/session_rounds/{roundId}.description: Per-user completed round logs synced in real time.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted administrator registry keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/admin_config/{configId}.description: Server-side admin configuration toggles and notices.

/maintenance_logs/{logId}.description: Administrator maintenance and configuration audit logs.
